cases.sentence: Царь Ксеркс наложил дань на все ___.
cases.translation: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on all kingdom.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'наложил' (laid) governs the accusative case.

cases.translation: The Jew Mordecai was second after the king.
cases.explain: The preposition 'после' (after) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: He worked for the good of his people.
cases.explain: The preposition 'для' (implied 'благо') governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Множество соплеменников глубоко чтило его и помогало ___ народу.
cases.translation: Many compatriots deeply honored him and helped the Jewish people.
cases.explain: The verb 'помогало' (helped) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Его деяния записаны в ___ Мидии и Персии.
cases.translation: His deeds are written in the books of Media and Persia.
cases.explain: The verb 'записаны' (recorded) with the preposition 'в' can govern accusative or prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Его величие чтили все ___ Мидии и Персии.
cases.translation: All kings of Media and Persia honored his greatness.
cases.explain: The noun in genitive expresses possession (kings of...); plural genitive form.

cases.translation: Mordecai spoke for the prosperity of all Jews.
cases.explain: The preposition 'всех' (of all) requires the genitive case; plural genitive.

cases.sentence: Дань была наложена до самых далеких ___ царства.
cases.translation: Tribute was laid on the remotest shores of the kingdom.
cases.explain: The preposition 'до' (until/to) governs the genitive case; plural genitive form.

reading.ru: Величие Мардахея Царь Ксеркс наложил дань на все царство до самых далеких его побережий.
reading.question: What did King Ahasuerus do to his entire kingdom?
options: He imposed a tribute on all his kingdom
He distributed wealth to all his kingdom
He expanded his kingdom across many shores
He released his subjects from taxation
reading.correct: He imposed a tribute on all his kingdom
reading.explain: The text states: 'Царь Ксеркс наложил дань на все царство' (King Ahasuerus laid/imposed tribute on all kingdom).

reading.ru: Иудей Мардахей был вторым после царя Ксеркса, он был велик среди иудеев, и множество соплеменников глубоко чтило его.
reading.question: What was Mordecai's position and status?
options: He was second only to King Ahasuerus and greatly honored by the Jews
He was the highest authority among the Jews
He served as the king's chief advisor only
He was a wealthy merchant respected by all people
reading.correct: He was second only to King Ahasuerus and greatly honored by the Jews
reading.explain: The text clearly states: 'был вторым после царя Ксеркса' (was second after King Ahasuerus) and 'множество соплеменников глубоко чтило его' (a multitude of his countrymen deeply honored him).

reading.ru: Все дела его власти и могущества и полный рассказ о величии Мардахея, которым наделил его царь, записаны в летописи царей Мидии и Персии.
reading.question: Where were the accounts of Mordecai's deeds and greatness recorded?
options: In the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia
In personal journals kept by Mordecai
In letters written to various provinces
In synagogue records throughout the kingdom
reading.correct: In the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia
reading.explain: The text explicitly states: 'записаны в летописи царей Мидии и Персии' (recorded in the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia).

reading.ru: Он трудился на благо своего народа и говорил ради благополучия всех иудеев.
reading.question: For what purpose did Mordecai work and speak?
options: For the benefit of his people and the well-being of all Jews
To gain personal wealth and influence
To challenge the authority of the king
To establish himself as a prophet among the Jews
reading.correct: For the benefit of his people and the well-being of all Jews
reading.explain: The text states: 'Он трудился на благо своего народа и говорил ради благополучия всех иудеев' (He worked for the good of his people and spoke for the well-being of all Jews).

reading.ru: Множество соплеменников глубоко чтило его, потому что он трудился на благо своего народа.
reading.question: Why did Mordecai's compatriots deeply honor him?
options: Because he worked for the benefit of his people
Because he was the wealthiest man in the kingdom
Because he was appointed by the Persian king
Because he defeated the kingdom's enemies in battle
reading.correct: Because he worked for the benefit of his people
reading.explain: The text shows the reason: 'потому что он трудился на благо своего народа' (because he worked for the good/benefit of his people).

reading.ru: Нет на земле такого человека, как он, непорочного и праведного, кто живет в страхе перед Богом и сторонится зла.
reading.question: What qualities are attributed to this man in the passage?
options: He is blameless, upright, fears God, and turns away from evil
He is the richest and most powerful in the land
He is a skilled warrior and military strategist
He is a prophet chosen by God to lead the people
reading.correct: He is blameless, upright, fears God, and turns away from evil
reading.explain: The text explicitly lists these qualities: 'непорочного и праведного, кто живет в страхе перед Богом и сторонится зла' (blameless and upright, who lives in fear before God and turns away from evil).
